cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: Here We Go Again
cards.instruction: Use every new disagreement to prove the same relationship pattern is repeating, then raise the consequences.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: A cancellation goes in the dinner chat before seven. Not at eleven, when I'm scraping it into the bin. We've covered this.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then use the office phone. Please distinguish an obstacle from having no options. Tomorrow I serve at seven and clear at eight.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll borrow a phone. Just leave my plate in the oven.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: No. That is how last Tuesday's dinner stayed warm until bedtime. From tomorrow, put your own meal in the oven. Uncooked.

cardFidelity.evidence: A1 teaches cancellation timing; A3 corrects the dead-battery excuse; A5 uses B4's oven request as repetition and withdraws cooking.

relationship.evidence: B4 offers compliance with calling while protecting access to a cooked dinner.

heightening.evidence: A5 raises the consequence from a clearing deadline to B cooking independently.

specificity.evidence: A1 locates the dispute in a shared dinner chat and food discarded at eleven.

brevityWit.evidence: A5's uncooked qualification is needed to make the new responsibility concrete.
